The '''Corellian Trade Spine''' was a major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]]. It began at [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and headed towards the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], in the direction of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. It passed [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]] before intersecting the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] at [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul]]. As it continued it passed through the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of space (which contains the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]]) before intersecting the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and exiting into open inter-galactic space.

==History==
The Corellian Trade Spine was first established around [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] as a spur of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], however it was not completed until [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was built incrementally over the centuries. Most of the outer spine beyond Yag'Dhul was relatively new, with parts having been opened only within the last few centuries [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] by [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] it was [[Raids along the Corellian Trade Spine|subjected]] to [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] raids from [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] it was raided by [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], originating from [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Imperial officer turned Warlord [[Inos Fonada]] would use the Spine to send his accumulated fleet of vessels to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] during the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn Crisis]].
